body:
Eighth sweep: the out-of-core path, chosen because it underpins the scale claims and appears in no vignette. No defects. Both routes are BITWISE EXACT:

  file_matrix_source, raw binary written and read back
    contrast total vs in-memory   max|diff| = 0    IDENTICAL

  storage = 'block', disk-backed store
    contrast total vs in-memory   max|diff| = 0    IDENTICAL
    store created, class reported as block_backed

Zero, not a tolerance. The out-of-core path is the same computation with a different residency, not an approximation of it.

THE PATTERN IS NOW THE FINDING, and I think it outranks anything individual I have filed. Three sweeps in a row have turned up genuine, verified capabilities that the documentation hides:

  the unification claim      node effects and coupling really are blocks of one operator.
                             Block decomposition exact to diff 0, diagonal matching hand
                             computation to 2.22e-16. Demonstrated nowhere.
  unequal-axis forms         measurement_form(left, right) really does execute forms whose
                             axes carry different named bases. The vignette shows a matrix
                             product the reader could have written themselves.
  the out-of-core path       bitwise exact. No vignette, no example, and it is the answer to
                             'can I run this on a real brain', which is the first question
                             any adopter asks.

So the sharpest structural statement this review can make is not that the documentation is hard to read, though it is, and not that the API is fragmented, though it is. It is that THE THREE THINGS MOST LIKELY TO WIN AN ADOPTER ARE THE THREE THINGS A READER CANNOT SEE.

That reframes the remediation priority. I have been ranking fixes by cost - the one-sentence G citation, the two-character include=FALSE change. Those are still right and still cheap. But the highest-VALUE change is a short section carrying one runnable demonstration of each of the three above: exact block decomposition, an unequal-axis form through the engine, and a file-backed geometry agreeing with memory to zero. Three chunks, nothing to build, every one works today.

Filed as bd-01KZYR0Y29S6G7FVY2VP61QZFW.

Eight sweeps, thirty-five findings. Running shape unchanged and now very well evidenced: every defect in the surface; every mathematical, statistical, operational and storage claim I have been able to test holding, most of them exactly.
